summary: The change normalizes same-repository sibling ordering in the step fingerprint so a Git reload in ID order no longer re-wakes every settled record, and adds a fake-port regression covering a 60-record reordered reload plus a real sibling head change.

evidence: step-inputs.ts sorts same-repository sibling shapes by id before hashing, so intake append order versus Git ID order no longer changes the digest
the new loop-input-gate test reorders 60 records through orderRecords and asserts all 60 are skipped with no write, then a sibling head change still steps all 60
no throughput threshold was raised; only the focused fingerprint normalization and its regression test changed
